$comment: Fan-out Template Sync discovers its targets from GitHub's template_repository
marker, so a repository generated from this template is picked up with no
edit here. This file covers the two cases the marker cannot express.
include: repositories that genuinely derive from the template but carry no
marker, because they predate its use as a template. A repository that merely
looks like a customer repo does not belong here — ps-customer-pwc, for
instance, was never derived from the template and must not be synced into.
exclude: derived repositories to leave alone, for example an engagement that
has ended or one being migrated by hand.
